canvas_subtitle: Computer Science Student - BUT2 - University Grenoble Alpes
experience_project_analyse_desc: Used SQL queries to extract, clean, and structure data from a database. The information was then exported to CSV format, resulting in the creation of a summary report presenting the results obtained and the key insights derived from the analysis. This project demonstrates skills in database management, data analysis, and report writing.
experience_project_chatbot_desc: Development of a Java-based chatbot capable of intelligently responding to user questions. The program analyzes incoming messages and generates suitable responses based on the structure of the requests. This project applies skills in object-oriented programming and algorithmic logic.
experience_project_quiz_desc: Online quiz developed using the Flask framework in Python, generating a personalized result based on user answers. This project implements the creation of web interfaces, form processing, and server-side business logic.
experience_project_genevent_desc: Development of a local desktop application in Java and JavaFX dedicated to the management of a music festivals. The program enables the planning and administration of all logistical aspects of events: festival creation, artist management, venue/terrain layout, contract handling, and coordination of service providers and vendors. This project demonstrates proficiency in object-oriented programming, graphical user interface design (JavaFX), and relational data structuring.
experience_project_snake_desc: Development of a Snake game in C, compiled to WebAssembly for execution in the web browser. The program manages the game's entire algorithmic logic: collision handling, snake movement, random food generation, and scoring system. This project showcases skills in low-level programming, WebAssembly compilation, and algorithmic logic applied to video games.
about_intro_desc: Currently seeking an internship with the goal of continuing into a work-study program (alternance), I aim to contribute my skills to ambitious projects. Curious, rigorous, and a strong team player, I am eager to fully commit to a dynamic environment where I can learn, contribute, and grow professionally.
about_pc_desc: Designing and building my own custom PC allowed me to develop a structured methodology: benchmarking components, technical optimization, and troubleshooting. This experience reflects my attention to detail and my ability to lead a technical project from start to finish.
about_sport_desc: Engaging in swimming, triathlon, running, and weight training, sports serve as my foundation for self-improvement and perseverance. These values instill in me strong resilience, solid teamwork abilities, and daily discipline that seamlessly translate into my professional projects.
about_culture_desc: Growing up in a bilingual French-English environment, I navigate multicultural contexts with ease. This strong interpersonal adaptability and open-mindedness enable me to integrate quickly and communicate effectively within any team.
about_worlds_desc: Passionate about fictional universes, I love analyzing how creators reinvent real-world cultures, mythologies, and societal structures. This passion constantly feeds my creativity, synthesis abilities, and keen eye for detail.
section_cv_desc: For a more detailed view of my skills and experience, I invite you to consult my CV below.
2nd_p1_desc_p1: This project involved architecting a speedy, Java-based chatbot engineered to parse and respond to natural language queries. To maximize efficiency, I implemented a custom lookup index to ensure an instantaneous word search. Furthermore, to overcome vocabulary barriers, the backend incorporates an integrated thesaurus system that synchronizes words based on semantic meaning, allowing the chatbot to accurately capture user intent even when different phrasing is used.
2nd_p1_desc_p2: At the core of its algorithmic logic is a sophisticated sentence 'calculator' designed to analyze the syntax and structural pattern of incoming questions. This allows the bot to dynamically formulate responses that align with the user's grammatical order for a more natural conversational flow. To showcase the application, our team developed a dedicated frontend interface and deployed the entire system via a locally hosted web server, connecting the Java logic with a clean UI.
2nd_p2_desc_p1: This project involved developing an interactive personality quiz using the Flask framework in Python, engineered to determine a personalized Pokémon elemental type for each user based on their inputs. The backend dynamically parses a structured JSON file containing all questions, answers, and strategic point allocations. These points are mapped directly to specific indices within a tracking array allocated to each Pokémon type, ensuring clean data handling during form processing.
2nd_p2_desc_p2: To achieve absolute algorithmic fairness, I implemented a mathematical readjustment layer at the final evaluation phase. This calculation normalizes the maximum possible score for every single category, ensuring that all Pokémon types have an mathematically equal opportunity to be selected, neutralizing any questionnaire bias for a genuinely tailored, personalized result. This project showcases proficiency in server-side routing, JSON parsing, and algorithmic data normalization.
2nd_p3_desc_p1: This project involved refining massive nutritional datasets extracted from the global OpenFoodFacts database, specifically focusing on the processed meat sector in France. Utilizing targeted SQL queries, I extracted, structured, and engineered raw data while aggressively filtering out aberrant data points and corrupted anomalies. This critical data-cleansing phase transformed an unstable public dataset into a reliable foundation for statistical analysis.
2nd_p3_desc_p2: Once structured, the data was exported into R to build comprehensive statistical graphs and map out macro-nutritional trends. The analysis deep-dived into the specific variables that dictate food health grades, identifying exactly which components, such as excessive grease, sugars, and sodium will drag a product's grade down, versus positive drivers like high protein content. The final deliverables culminated in an executive summary report detailing key market insights and processing standards.
